## Equations
### EQC001 — Biorthogonal normalization and equality of four Chern numbers

*Defines the two-dimensional topological invariant and proves it is independent of left/right Berry-connection choice.*

$$
N_n^{LL}=N_n^{LR}=N_n^{RL}=N_n^{RR},\qquad N_n^{\alpha\beta}=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{BZ}\epsilon_{ij}B_{n,ij}^{\alpha\beta}d^2k
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equations: paper-source/nonHermitian.tex:65-83; main Eqs. (1)-(3); supplement_sections: raw/supplementary/supplement.pdf, Sections I-III

Numerical form:

```
Analytic proof; optional lattice discretization of biorthogonal links is supporting evidence only.
```


### EQC002 — Generalized non-Hermitian Dirac spectrum and exceptional-point positions

*Generates the continuum bulk spectra, separability boundary, phase diagram, and exceptional-point trajectories.*

$$
E_\pm=\pm\sqrt{k^2-\kappa^2+m^2-\delta^2+2i(\mathbf{k}\cdot\boldsymbol{\kappa}+m\delta)}
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equations: paper-source/nonHermitian.tex:87-99; main Eq. (4) and dispersion; paper_equation: paper-source/nonHermitian.tex:196-201; exceptional-point positions

Numerical form:

```
Vectorized complex radicand and its two square-root sheets; closed-form EP coordinates.
```

$$

### EQC005 — Square-lattice non-Hermitian cylinder Hamiltonian

*Defines the open-x, periodic-y cylinder spectra and chiral edge branches in Supplement Fig. 3.*

$$
H(\mathbf{k})=(\sin k_x+i\kappa_x)\sigma_x+(\sin k_y+i\kappa_y)\sigma_y+(\cos k_x+\cos k_y+m+i\delta)\sigma_z
$$

$$
